summary: The company will design a remote control targeting 15-35 year olds, focusing on TV control only. It will have a unique, fashionable design with corporate color and slogan 'Putting the fashion in electronics'. Basic functions include volume, channel, and skip. Speech recognition is considered but has limitations. The design aims to be easy to use and high-tech.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 2
evidence.text: The company has decided to exclude tele-text from the remote control's functionality due to the internet's popularity.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 2
evidence.text: The remote control will only be used to control the television, not the VCR, DVD, or other devices.
